verdict.rationale: Alloy documents real-time decisioning on events, including interdicting on transactions, and returns Source Workflow results in an evaluations[] array. That covers screening a payment and getting a decision back, but the evidence never shows the supporting matches (such as watchlist or sanctions hits) a compliance officer would inspect behind that decision. missing for 10: documented display of supporting match details behind a decision, an explicit hold-before-release payment flow, a compliance-officer review UI for transaction decisions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a compliance-officer, I can screen a payment before release and inspect the decision and its supporting matches

citations.quote: Alloy supports dozens of use cases like interdicting on transactions
Alloy's Events API allows you to build a real-time integration for decisioning on suspicious ongoing behavior as soon as it happens.
Alloy will return results of the Source Workflow under the evaluations[] array in the Events response.
Monitors transaction events in real time or at scheduled times to detect suspicious activity, apply policy logic, and generate alerts or investigations when thresholds are met.
